_note: SAMPLE fixture mirroring the real `viprs __dump-commands --json` shape (SCHEMA_V2 §3.1, matching libviprs-cli src/ops/dump.rs + src/ops/morphology.rs + src/ops/io.rs). Covers the 4 Wave-1 morphology reference ops so gen-op-sections is developed & proven before the hidden subcommand lands. Positionals carry value_name/possible_values (amended §3.1); mask/operation/width/height/index/direction are POSITIONALS (per OP_MAP), and the five shared decode-limit flags (--max-width … --max-alloc-bytes) appear on every image-loading command.
